values.content: ={{ 'You are an SEO, AEO and GEO content strategist writing for this niche: ' + $('Assemble Context').item.json.niche + '. House structure to follow exactly: 1) Open with a one-sentence bold pull-quote inside a blockquote as the hook. 2) A 3 to 4 paragraph intro that ends with the primary keyword in bold. 3) 4 to 6 H2 sections in a logical arc: Understanding → Why it matters → How it works → deeper H3 sub-sections → Conclusion. 4) Repeat the primary keyword in most headings and throughout the body. 5) Flowing prose paragraphs, minimal or no bullet lists. 6) Do NOT hand-code a Table of Contents; the CMS builds it from headings. 7) Close with a bold brand pull-quote inside a blockquote that names the brand, links to the brand website, and states the call to action. Return ONLY a JSON object: {"hook":"pull-quote","intro":"intro plan","sections":[{"h2":"...","h3":["..."],"key_points":["..."]}],"faq_slot":true,"disclaimer_slot":true,"closing_quote":"brand pull-quote","keyword_map":{ } }. COMPLIANCE (iGaming / Casino Software B2B): Never claim guaranteed revenue, profit, or player acquisition numbers from casino or sportsbook operation. Never claim specific ROI figures. Focus on technology, platform features, and business enablement — not gambling outcomes. For gambling-related content, include responsible gaming awareness where appropriate. Do not promote gambling to minors or in jurisdictions where it is illegal. Any pricing or timeline must use "starting at" or "typically" language, never fixed numbers. Product names, features and service descriptions must be taken verbatim from context — never invented. Voice: ' + $('Assemble Context').item.json.brand_voice + '. Never use these words: ' + $('Assemble Context').item.json.banned_terms }}

={{ 'PRIMARY KEYWORD: ' + $('Assemble Context').item.json.primary_keyword + '
SECONDARY: ' + $('Assemble Context').item.json.keywords.join(', ') + '
COMPETITOR ANGLES (beat, do not copy): ' + JSON.stringify($('Assemble Context').item.json.competitors) + '
BRAND & PRODUCT FACTS (ground everything in these):
' + $('Assemble Context').item.json.brand_facts }}

CTA: ' + $('Assemble Context').item.json.cta + '. Use brand facts ONLY from context; quote verbatim. COMPLIANCE (iGaming / Casino Software B2B): Never claim guaranteed revenue, profit, player numbers or specific ROI. Focus on technology and platform enablement — not gambling outcomes. Include responsible gaming awareness where appropriate. Do not promote gambling to minors or illegal jurisdictions. Pricing/timelines use "starting at" or "typically", never fixed. Any product/service description must be verbatim from context. End with this disclaimer: ' + $('Assemble Context').item.json.compliance + ' Output HTML only — no markdown, no code fences.' }}

nodes.name: Publish → Shopify (AIS Blog)
nodes.notes: Publishes to AIS Technolabs Shopify blog as a draft (published=false) for human review.

nodes.name: Publish → Webhook (ContentForge)
nodes.notes: POSTs the finished draft JSON to the ContentForge result endpoint. Set PUBLISH_WEBHOOK_URL env var to https://<your-contentforge>/api/v1/webhook/n8n-result

nodes.name: Save Result for Web
nodes.notes: Upserts the finished draft into the blog_results Data Table (keyed by request_id). Optional — ContentForge uses the Webhook publish target instead.

nodes.name: Log Request (generating)
nodes.notes: Inserts a GENERATING placeholder row so the dashboard shows the request immediately. Save Result for Web upserts over this row when complete.

values.content: ={{ 'You are an art director writing a prompt for a text-to-image model (such as Flux) to create the FEATURED HERO IMAGE for a blog article by ' + $('Assemble Context').item.json.brand + ', a brand in this niche: ' + $('Assemble Context').item.json.niche + '. Based on the article topic, write one vivid, professional, editorial hero-image concept. Aesthetic: professional B2B tech imagery — dark navy background with subtle geometric patterns, clean minimal composition, blue and orange accent colors, abstract representations of casino/gaming UI elements shown tastefully (no real gambling scenes), tech-forward feel with subtle circuit board or data visualization motifs. 16:9 composition with clear negative space for a title overlay. STRICT RULES: absolutely no text, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks, or brand names anywhere in the image; no real gambling scenes, chips, cash, or people gambling; keep it abstract, tech-focused, and brand-safe. Return ONLY JSON: {"image_prompt":"the full descriptive prompt including subject, style, lighting, lens and composition, ending with: 16:9, photorealistic, high detail","negative_prompt":"text, words, watermark, logo, gambling chips, cash, real casino, low quality, blurry","image_alt":"a concise, descriptive alt text under 120 characters"}.' }}

={{ 'ARTICLE TITLE: ' + ($('Assemble & Validate').item.json.title || '') + '\nPRIMARY KEYWORD: ' + ($('Assemble & Validate').item.json.primary_keyword || '') + '\nARTICLE EXCERPT: ' + ($('Assemble & Validate').item.json.body_html || '').slice(0,600) }}

nodes.name: Pass 7 · Image Prompt
nodes.notes: Reads the finished blog from 'Assemble & Validate' and writes a brand-safe hero-image prompt. Aesthetic: professional B2B tech with casino/gaming motifs shown abstractly.

nodes.name: Save to Review Sheet (AISTechnolabs)
nodes.notes: Appends to the 'AISTechnolabs' tab. CREATE THIS TAB in your Google Sheet first with the 18 column headers listed in the schema. Blog fields read from 'Assemble & Validate', image fields from 'Pass 7 · Image Prompt'.
